BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal but remains only moderately constructive. ETH and SOL long signals are fragile due to low composite strength, elevated beta/volatility, and weak-to-moderate liquidity or institutional support. BCH, DOGE, and LTC have weak or negative supporting factors and should not receive added conviction. ETC is especially fragile: its zero price and missing volatility, liquidity, and expected-shortfall data make the long signal unusable for risk sizing.
